description: Task activity log for auditing task changes and events

columns.name: actor_user_id
columns.description: Optional user who triggered the event (null for automated events)

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Event type (Created, Updated, StatusChanged, Assigned, Unassigned, Commented, DueDateChanged, PriorityChanged, Tagged)

columns.name: from_value
columns.description: Optional previous value before the change

columns.name: to_value
columns.description: Optional new value after the change

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the activity was recorded
